series.name: Table C — Axpert VM II Premium (mirror)
series.notes: Variant deltas only (wording); rest identical to Table A. Mirror-hosted → medium.

meaning.en: Same trip as Table A fault 02; VM II Premium adds NTC open as a cause.
meaning.ur: Table A fault 02 jaisa hi trip; VM II Premium mein NTC khula hone ko ek aur cause bhi add karta hai.

causes.en: Air flow blocked / ambient temperature too high.
Converter component over 120°C; inverter component over 100°C.
NTC is not connected well (VM II wording).
causes.ur: NTC theek se munsalik nahin (VM II).

solutions.en: Switch off AC input and PV, let the unit cool, and clear blocked vents; clean dust from the filters and heat sinks.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV band kar ke unit ko thanda hone dein, band vents kholein; filters aur heat sinks ki dhool saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check the NTC sensor connector on the board is pushed in properly and its wire is not broken (VM II wording).
solutions.ur: Board par NTC sensor ka connector theek se laga hai ya nahin aur us ki wire tooti to nahi, yeh check karein (VM II wording).

solutions.en: Restart with a lighter load and listen to the fan; if the trip returns with clear airflow, have the NTC and fan checked at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Halka load kar ke restart karein aur pankha sun kar dekhein; hawa saaf hone ke baad bhi trip aaye to NTC aur pankha service centre se check karwayein.
